messages.subject: facets scale control
parts:
Given this code

facet_wrap(~factor, scales = "free", ncol = 2)

I would like to override the default scale settings in order to set my
own with predefined limits and breaks both for x and y axis for each
one of the resulting chart (in my case four), is that possible?

I know about the option “free_x” or “free_y” but I would like to have
more flexibility in order to control the scale for each one of the
resulting charts by specifying x and y limits and breaks

Any help for that?

thanks

max

messages.subject: Re: Re: facets scale control
parts:
Is there a way to draw scale_continuous with a formatter which was based on quantiles. 

As an example, I have data on BMI, which ranges from  16 (wait) to >50)  and of course the estimated rates are unstable at the rarest BMIs.   I'd like to keep the BMI scaling so that individuals have that frame of reference to the substantive materials, but I'd like to have them focus on the core of the datset, and not have the visual impression of the graph based on the last centile(s).  This seems like a job for a formatter, not unlike the log, percentage and related extant formatters.

Possible?


Rob
